text: MIP Real Assets (Mexico Infrastructure Partners) is an independent, partner-owned energy and infrastructure investment manager, founded in 2012 and headquartered in Mexico City.
short: MIP: independent, partner-owned Mexican infrastructure manager.

source.name: Mexico Infrastructure Partners: MIP Real Assets Plans to Invest $12+ Billion to Support Mexico's Next Infrastructure Cycle
source.quote: An independent, partner-owned firm headquartered in Mexico City with international presence in the Americas, Europe and the Gulf Region
